units.source: Customizing to-do task states
units.context: Customizing to-do task states

units.source: Trilium features customizable to-do list task states. To customize them, go to __TRILIUM_PH_0__Options__TRILIUM_PH_1__ → __TRILIUM_PH_2__Text Notes__TRILIUM_PH_3__ → __TRILIUM_PH_4__Related settings__TRILIUM_PH_5__ → __TRILIUM_PH_6__Custom checkbox states for to-do lists__TRILIUM_PH_7__. Alternatively, right-click a checkbox in an editable text note and click the pencil icon; on the __TRILIUM_PH_8__Mobile Frontend__TRILIUM_PH_9__, the pencil icon is in the row of the __TRILIUM_PH_10__List ›__TRILIUM_PH_11__ button of a to-do list.
units.context: Customizing to-do task states

units.source: Changes take effect only after restarting the application.
units.context: Customizing to-do task states

units.source: Creating a new task state__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Customizing to-do task states > Creating a new task state

units.source: Click the plus icon next to Task States in the left-side pane, then define the task details as described in the next section.
units.context: Customizing to-do task states > Creating a new task state

units.source: Editing a task state__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Customizing to-do task states > Editing a task state

units.source: Selecting any state other than "None" and "Done" (which cannot be modified) from the side pane reveals the following editable fields:
units.context: Customizing to-do task states > Editing a task state

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Icon__TRILIUM_PH_1__ (required): The symbol shown inside the checkbox. You can pick an icon just as you would for any regular note, including from custom icon packs.
units.context: Customizing to-do task states > Editing a task state

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Title__TRILIUM_PH_1__ (required): The name of the task state shown in the UI. For example: "Doing", "Postponed".
units.context: Customizing to-do task states > Editing a task state

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Identifier__TRILIUM_PH_1__ (required): A short name for the state, using only letters, digits, "__TRILIUM_PH_2__" and "__TRILIUM_PH_3__". It is stored as metadata in the note's markup and used to identify the task state. Two task states cannot share the same identifier.__TRILIUM_PH_4__Prefix the identifiers of your custom task states with an underscore "__TRILIUM_PH_5__" or a hyphen "__TRILIUM_PH_6__" to avoid clashes with task states that may be introduced in future versions of Trilium.
units.context: Customizing to-do task states > Editing a task state

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Markdown symbol__TRILIUM_PH_1__: A single character used to represent the state in Markdown syntax. For example, "__TRILIUM_PH_2__" creates a task state that can be applied in Markdown using " __TRILIUM_PH_3__ ". Make sure no other task state uses the same symbol.
units.context: Customizing to-do task states > Editing a task state

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Counts as completed__TRILIUM_PH_1__: If checked, the task is treated as completed.
units.context: Customizing to-do task states > Editing a task state

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Color__TRILIUM_PH_1__: The color of the checkbox. Its lightness and saturation are adjusted automatically to match the current color scheme or theme.
units.context: Customizing to-do task states > Editing a task state

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Hidden from toolbar__TRILIUM_PH_1__: The state is not listed in the UI. This is useful when you want existing notes to keep rendering the state correctly but no longer need to apply it yourself.
units.context: Customizing to-do task states > Editing a task state

units.source: The task definition details are validated at startup. If errors are found, a toast provides the details and the affected task definition is ignored.
units.context: Customizing to-do task states > Editing a task state

units.source: Reordering task states__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Customizing to-do task states > Reordering task states

units.source: To change the order in which task states appear in the UI and when cycling through them with the keyboard, simply reorder the states in the side pane (or tree panel, if it's the case).
units.context: Customizing to-do task states > Reordering task states

units.source: Deleting task states__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Customizing to-do task states > Deleting task states

units.source: Any task state other than "None" and "Done" can be deleted.
units.context: Customizing to-do task states > Deleting task states

units.source: Once deleted, to-do items using that state will no longer display the custom checkbox. They fall back to either a "None" or "Done" state, depending on the state's "Counts as completed" setting. The identifier and title remain stored in the note until you set the checkbox to a new state.
units.context: Customizing to-do task states > Deleting task states

units.source: Transferring notes with custom task states between Trilium database instances__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Customizing to-do task states > Transferring notes with custom task states between Trilium database instances

units.source: Exporting notes to another Trilium database instance preserves the task states of to-do items, but does not include the custom task definitions. As a result, the destination instance won't know how to render the checkbox unless you recreate the task state there with the same identifier and Markdown symbol.
units.context: Customizing to-do task states > Transferring notes with custom task states between Trilium database instances

units.source: This is a known limitation of the current version. If there is enough interest in the community for transferring notes between Trilium database instances more easily, the Trilium team may consider a better state definition mechanism.
units.context: Customizing to-do task states > Transferring notes with custom task states between Trilium database instances
